llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render the tap target under `GestureHandlerRootView` and attach gestures with `GestureDetector gesture={...}` from `react-native-gesture-handler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: GestureHandlerRootView wraps the entire tree and GestureDetector gesture={composedGesture} is used to attach gestures to the tap target.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define both gestures with `Gesture.Tap()` builders (`singleTap` and `doubleTap`) using current builder callbacks (`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both gestures are built with Gesture.Tap(), use onEnd callbacks, and no useAnimatedGestureHandler is present anywhere in the file.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `scheduleOnRN(...)` inside tap `onEnd` success paths to update React state and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onEnd callbacks call setState (setLastAction, setDoubleTapCount, setSingleTapCount) directly without wrapping in scheduleOnRN(...). runOnJS is also absent, but the requirement mandates scheduleOnRN specifically.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compose taps with `Gesture.Exclusive(doubleTap, singleTap)` so exclusivity is defined by RNGH composition APIs.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Gesture.Exclusive(doubleTap, singleTap) is used, giving doubleTap priority per RNGH composition API.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure tap-recognition windows via `Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(2).maxDelay(...)` for double tap and `Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(1)` for single tap, with explicit duration limits via `maxDuration(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: doubleTap uses .numberOfTaps(2) and .maxDuration(300) but is missing .maxDelay(...) which the requirement explicitly mandates for double tap recognition. singleTap correctly uses .numberOfTaps(1) and .maxDuration(500).
